title: Atlas DataFlow Registry Promotion Update
description: Safe registry active-release update contract for the first public cycle. Defines the inputs and rules required to change the active_release field in the file-based registry through a controlled promotion operation. Direct writes to active_release outside the promotion path are not authorized by this contract. This schema does not implement registry write logic, hash calculation, signing, queues, workers, databases, public endpoints, or web administration.

update_kind.description: Distinguishes this controlled registry update from a direct write, a manual edit, or a public administration event.

dataset_slug.description: Stable dataset identifier from the registry entry being updated. Must match an existing dataset_slug in the registry.

incoming_release_id.description: The release_id that will become the new active_release for the target dataset. Must have passed all promotion preconditions per the promotion-rules schema.

previous_active_release_id.description: The release_id that was active in the registry before this update, or null if the dataset has no previous active release. Must be explicitly recorded; must not be discarded or overwritten silently.

update_rules.description: Rules that must be satisfied for this registry update to be considered safe.

active_release_update_through_promotion_.description: The active_release field in the registry may only be changed by a promotion operation that has verified all preconditions per the promotion-rules schema.

direct_registry_write_authorized.description: Direct manual writes to active_release outside the controlled promotion path are not authorized.

file_based_validity_preserved_before_upd.description: The registry file must pass structural validation per the published-dataset-registry schema before the active_release field is updated.

file_based_validity_preserved_after_upda.description: The registry file must pass structural validation per the published-dataset-registry schema after the active_release field is updated.

previous_release_reference_recorded.description: The previous_active_release_id must be explicitly recorded in the promotion result before the registry update is applied. It must not be discarded.

silent_overwrite_prevented.description: The promotion operation must record the previous active_release_id before applying the update. A silent replacement that discards the previous release reference is rejected.

one_active_release_per_dataset.description: Each dataset has exactly one active_release at any time for the first public cycle. The update replaces the existing active_release value rather than adding a second one.

update_boundaries.description: Operations that are explicitly excluded from this registry update contract.

registry_write_implemented.description: This schema defines the registry update contract and does not implement registry write logic.

concurrent_write_supported.description: Concurrent multi-user registry writes are not supported in the first public cycle. The update assumes a single-user-at-a-time promotion flow.
